content: Screening for complications of chronic kidney disease (CKD) involves assessing for metabolic bone disease. This requires the evaluation of serum calcium levels to monitor calcium homeostasis. Parathyroid hormone (PTH) levels must be assessed to identify secondary hyperparathyroidism, which is common in CKD. Additionally, vitamin D levels should be evaluated to determine any deficiencies or insufficiencies that may contribute to bone and mineral disorders.
